name: St Joseph and St Peter, Newchurch

boundary.description: From the inflow into Clowbridge Reservoir at Limy Water (Rossendale – Burnley District boundary). SE by the Rossendale - Burnley District boundary to the E side of Clough Bottom Reservoir, S by a straight line to Newchurch Old Road at its junction with the footpath then by a line drawn between the Fernhill estate (Rawtenstall and Newchurch parish) and the Rockcliffe Estate (Bacup and Whitworth parish) to the steps on Anvil Street, W along Anvil Street, Rushton St, crossing Newchurch Road, Glen Street and Lee Road to the SE corner of the cemetery, S by a straight line to the civil parish boundary stone at Jackson’s Moor. S to the boundary stone at Old Slink Slack and W by the Rossendale - Rochdale District boundary to and along the track (Rossendale Way) passing S of Cowpe Lowe, to Higher Mount Pleasant. Then N crossing Hill End Lane, and Bacup Road (A681), then N by Peel Street, Dobbin Lane, Edge Lane and by a bee-line to the inflow into Clowbridge Reservoir at Limy Water.
